Karen Vestergaard Andersen is a clinical nurse specialist affiliated with Aarhus University Hospital in the Central Denmark Region (Region Midtjylland) [^src1]. She is documented in the 2023 annual report for the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB), a national database operating under the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1].

Within the database's governance structure, Andersen serves as the representative for the Danish Nursing Society (Dansk Sygepleje Selskab) on the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]] [^src1]. Her presence on the committee reflects the interdisciplinary and cross-regional composition of the database's leadership, ensuring that professional nursing expertise contributes to clinical quality development and the evaluation of healthcare indicators [^src1]. Aside from her role and affiliations listed in the 2023 steering committee roster, the available corpus does not provide further claims, timeline events, or additional details regarding her specific contributions.
